The key to our success lies in our teachers. We take great care in selecting and retaining the most highly skilled teachers who show a passion for both the learning and the teaching process.

At Premier we believe it is our responsibility to strive for excellence in all aspects of our students' development. College Counseling — Our Programs – Premier Academy
Over 20 years successfully preparing and sending students to the best universities in the United States.
We specialize in assisting students prepare for the college application process and are committed to help students gain admission to the nation's top universities.
Counseling is a multi-year relationship, not a senior-year scramble. We work with families from course selection in the early high school years all the way through financial aid awards.
Course selection year by year, extracurricular recommendations that build a coherent profile, planning calendars, and ongoing admissions updates.
Personal assessments, exploration of 300+ courses of study, and career information including income and job-growth forecasts.
Transcript, GPA and SAT evaluation; search criteria; reach/match/safety recommendations; and hands-on application support.
Writing guidance with up to two edits per essay, assistance up to 21 days before deadlines, and a focus on grammar, structure and authenticity.
Interview preparation and coaching, including mock interviews and feedback on presentation and content.
Scholarship eligibility review, FAFSA and CSS PROFILE guidance, and a combined merit and need-based strategy.
Individualized identification of private scholarships and grants matched to each student’s profile.

As a transfer student, how can I get into my dream university?
Transfer admission rewards a clear story. We help students build one.

Transfer applications are judged differently from freshman applications. Committees want to know why you are moving, what you have already accomplished, and why their program is the right destination.
Premier Academy works with transfer applicants from community colleges and four-year universities alike, on both the written materials and the strategy behind them.
What a strong transfer application does
Identify what distinguishes the applicant academically and personally, and make that the spine of the application.
State clearly why this university and this major, with specifics that could not be copied into another application.
Explain the move in a way that reads as progress and intent rather than escape.
Personal statements, brainstorming sessions, essay revision, and grammar and structure review.
Major selection, university analysis, and strategic planning across the full transfer timeline.

Middle school and high school boarding school applications in the United States.
Premier Academy can help you apply to a school in the USA early, before college starts.

We have connections with, and knowledge of, the best private and boarding schools in America. The earlier your child enters school in the United States, the stronger their position when college applications come around.
Are students guaranteed to get successfully placed?
Yes. We guarantee at least one successful placement minimum or your money back. Our company will only accept students we feel have a high probability of successful placement.
My student’s English level is very low. Can they come to America for study?

Yes. Premier Academy has relationships with many schools across the country which take students at a very beginning English level. We would most likely place your student into a school with a special ELD/ESL curriculum.
Will you consult for the US visa application, including the I-20 invitation letter and F-1 Student Visa?
Yes. Part of our service is ensuring that both the I-20 invitation letter and F-1 Student Visa are correctly issued. We also help prepare you for the US Embassy interview.
What cities in the United States do you place students to?
We cover Los Angeles, San Francisco and New York as the main three cities. Secondary cities include Chicago, Houston, Seattle and Atlanta.
How do you select the home stay sponsor families?

Premier Academy interviews many prospective families who want to be a sponsor family. Full background checks are performed and preference is given to those families with experience and a proven track record. Premier Academy also works directly with each school, many of which already perform their own pre-screening of families.
What is the cost of schooling vs. boarding?

School tuition ranges from as little as $15,000 USD per year to as high as $75,000 per year for boarding schools that include housing and meals where students live on campus. Home stay students can expect to pay anywhere from $1,800 to $2,500 each month for housing and meals. All prices vary depending on the school, family and location in the United States.
